definitions.explanation: Physical work that does not require heavy lifting, specialized skills, or strenuous effort. Commonly used in job listings for warehouse sorting, packaging, labeling, and similar tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽作業|けいさぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a part-time job doing light work at a warehouse.

examples.japanese: {軽作業|けいさぎょう}なら⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If it's light work, you can do it even without much stamina.

examples.japanese: ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{軽作業|けいさぎょう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{梱包|こんぽう}→梱包：07937_konpou⟧や⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧{貼|は}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I searched for "light work" on a job site, many packing and labeling jobs came up.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common terms in Japanese part-time job (⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧) listings. Typical tasks include sorting packages, applying labels, assembling simple products, and inspecting items. Often described as suitable for beginners ({未経験者歓迎|みけいけんしゃかんげい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽作業|けいさぎょう}⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧ (light work staff)
- {軽作業|けいさぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧ (light work job listing)
- ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧{軽作業|けいさぎょう} (warehouse light work)
